Installation of PandaRoot for Developers
========================================

# PandaRoot

This software is designed to the specific needs of the PANDA experiment. It is used to perform event generation, particle transport ("simulation"), detector digitisation and reconstruction, particle identification as well as event analysis.


### Installation
For **user installation** instructions please refer to [docs/Installation/Install_PandaRoot.md](docs/Installation/Install_PandaRoot.md)

If you do **development**, please follow the instructions in [docs/Installation/Install_Developers.md](docs/Installation/Install_Developers.md)

The installation at the **GSI cluster** Virgo is described in [docs/Installation/Install_GSI.md](docs/Installation/Install_GSI.md)

### Examples
To run a simulation chain with PandaRoot you can refer to `macro/master` which contains the most recent macros. More detailed examples and tutorials are found under `tutorials`. The most recent one is `tutorials/thailand2017`.

### Overview

There are many event generators, which can be found in `pgenerators`. The detector code is put at `detectors`. Under `geometry` the root geometries and related files are stored. 
The input and the parameters are located in `config`, `gconfig`, `input` and `macro/params`. Tracking and PID code is located in `tracking`, `genfit`, `genfit2` and `pid`. 
The analysis related classes are found in `analysis`. 
All data formats are separated from the actual algorithms and can be referenced in `pnddata`.

Under `macro/QA` you will find the quality assurance checks, which are performed each night. Their results can be found at [https://cdash.gsi.de/index.php?project=PandaRoot](https://cdash.gsi.de/index.php?project=PandaRoot).
